text:
Asha (CSM): Quick capture from PulseWave post-onboarding. They sent three product asks and one ops concern that they say could impact renewal. Need triage before renewal check-in 2026-04-06. Asks: 1) hide token-level billing per route (admin toggle), 2) one-click CSV export of flagged feedback for PM import, 3) per-project embedding cache TTL + manual invalidate. Ops: noisy retries on fallback variants during nightly jobs.

Priya (PM): thanks. Can you paste their exact lines and any sample CSV header? I need concrete fields to spec. Also rank by impact.

Asha (CSM): redacted excerpt: "Our finance reviewers are overwhelmed by token columns. We need an admin toggle to hide token details per route. Also, give us a CSV export of flagged transcripts so our PMs can bulk import into Jira. And allow invalidating the embedding cache after retrain."

Lena (Support): sample CSV they provided in ticket:
```
project,route,user_id,flagged_at,reason,snippet,model_variant
pulsewave,route-A,usr_321,2026-03-18T04:10:00Z,privacy,"please redact email",gptx-3-small
```

Gabe (CS-OPS): telemetry: PulseWave ~110k tokens/day; fallback rate last 7d ~12% with spikes 02:30-04:00 UTC. Nightly batch seems correlated. Retries are increasing concurrency and cost.

Jared (Eng): per-route billing toggle looks low effort: boolean on Route + UI switch + filter in billing export. Estimate 3 dev days + QA. CSV export: medium effort to implement exporter + access controls. Cache controls: larger UX/permission surface.

Priya (PM): my proposed prioritization: 1) billing toggle (high ROI, low cost), 2) CSV export (medium), 3) retry guard (short-term ops mitigation), 4) cache controls (longer cycle). Agree?

Gabe (CS-OPS): bump retry guard if nightly continues to drive cost. Recommend we add an alert: fallback_rate > 10% over 6h.

Jared (Eng): short-term retry mitigation: cap retries to 2 per request with exponential backoff. Emits metric fallback_limited. Quick POC ~2 dev days. Longer-term: circuit-breaker per variant.

Asha (CSM): action items: Asha get confirmed CSV fields from PulseWave (EOD); Priya draft PRD stub for toggle + CSV (this week); Jared POC retry cap + metric (by next Tue); Gabe add alert rule and add to sprint board; Lena prep demo CSV for sync.

comms-bot: Created ticket CS-3512 "PulseWave: billing toggle + feedback export + cache/ops mitigations" (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-3512).

Priya (PM): scheduling 30min sync with PulseWave next Wed, will invite eng & ops. Asha please include finance contact.

Asha (CSM): will do. They said renewal could be at risk without clearer billing: "If we can't mask token noise the CFO will push back." Add a slide to renewal deck.

Lena (Support): noted, prepping CSV demo and ingest notes.

Jared (Eng): paste for ticket (pseudo):
```
if (req.retryCount >= 2) {
  emitMetric('fallback_limited', true);
  return error('fallback_limit_reached');
}
await retryWithBackoff();
```

Gabe (CS-OPS): tagging @priya @jared: I'll instrument fallback_rate and set alert. Adding work to sprint now.

Asha (CSM): thanks team, target PRD + triage before renewal check-in on 2026-04-06. :thumbsup:

Priya (PM): will post updates in ticket and here.

(comms-bot): Ticket CS-3512 moved to "In Progress" by Priya.
